title: Girl on Brick Porch, Indianapolis Indiana - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sweet portrait of a young girl or teenager perched on the brick ledge of a residential front porch, flanked by large garden foliage and a white fan trellis covered in climbing ivy. She wears a light-colored summer dress featuring puffed sleeves and a wide Peter Pan collar, with a decorative floral clip or bow in her dark curled hair. Captured on the American home front in the midst of World War II on July 23, 1943, outside a home at 132 N. Traub Avenue in Indianapolis, Indiana.
